steps.command:
cd /testbed && source /opt/miniconda3/bin/activate && conda activate testbed && python3 -c "
import sympy as sp
from sympy.polys.orderings import monomial_key

x1, x2, x3 = sp.symbols('x1, x2, x3')
states = [x1, x2, x3]
max_degrees = 3
min_degrees = 3
monomials = sorted(sp.itermonomials(states, max_degrees, min_degrees=min_degrees),
                   key=monomial_key('grlex', states))
print(monomials)
"

cd /testbed && source /opt/miniconda3/bin/activate && conda activate testbed && PYTHONWARNINGS='ignore::UserWarning,ignore::SyntaxWarning' bin/test -C --verbose sympy/polys/tests/test_monomials.py sympy/polys/tests/test_polytools.py 2>&1 | tail -60
